notes:
SWIT QB Companion 2.0.0-beta.129

Record direct payment: the GL account list on the lines now includes the bank accounts. For example, a repayment paid from Sagicor Admin 5736 into the KI Children's Fund account.
The bank account the payment is made from can't also be a line, because money can't go out of and into the same account.
Bank rules that record a line as a direct payment can name a bank account too, though not the bank the rule is for.
In QuickBooks it is a cheque from the bank paid from, with an expense line on the other bank account.
